scope: First priority: read-only selected-subject versus prepared-artwork review, with optional cloud explanations. Not a completed autonomous digitizer.

owners.interface: design-review.js inside the existing detail panel; existing studio owns all options and edits

limitations: Checks subject-to-artwork only, at existing preview resolution. Original-to-subject and artwork-to-stitches checks remain future work.
Differences can be intentional palette changes. Zero candidates does not certify completeness or accuracy.
All changed components counted, largest 50 displayed, at most 8 candidate regions sent for AI explanations.
Moved/hidden pieces and local recovery patches are refused until coordinate mapping supports them. Native typed text stays on its own path.
AI cache is bounded to 32 results and in-flight deduplication is process-local. Multi-worker deployment needs shared deduplication and authentication before public launch.
Cancelling a sent cloud request cannot guarantee refund; existing worst-case budget reservation remains.
AI cannot restore details, change settings or override export warnings in this slice.

requires: Server-side OPENAI_API_KEY, never in frontend or chat
User-chosen per-design and monthly USD caps in the existing policy
Confirmed, dated pricing for this exact model
Per-request permission to send source, prepared image and crops

next_priorities: Configure confirmed spending limits and server credentials, then measure AI findings on labelled real examples; include unchanged controls and false positives.
